terrain.title: Terrain
terrain.mode.raise.tooltip: Raises the ground under the brush while the button is held
terrain.mode.lower.tooltip: Lowers the ground under the brush while the button is held
terrain.mode.smooth.tooltip: Evens the ground out towards the average around each point
terrain.mode.flatten.tooltip: Brings the ground to one height: where the stroke starts, or the height typed below
terrain.mode.roughen.tooltip: Adds the gentle rolls and dips of a natural field
terrain.mode.water.tooltip: Digs a lake or a river bed under the water of the tile, or 0.3 m under the ground where the stroke starts, and lays water on the tiles it reaches; it never fills
terrain.mode.ramp.tooltip: Click where it starts and where it ends: the ground between becomes one even slope as wide as the brush
terrain.radius.tooltip: How far the brush reaches, 3 to 150 m; it works fully in the middle and softly towards its rim
terrain.strength.tooltip: How fast the brush works while the button is held
terrain.flatten.tooltip: The height Flatten works towards; empty uses the height where each stroke starts
terrain.depth.tooltip: How deep Lake / river digs under the water's surface
@terrain.row.heights: Label of a row in the terrain tool's option column, at most about 9 characters: its two fields are the height Flatten works towards and the depth Lake / river digs
terrain.hint: Hold the left button over the ground to shape it; the ground never rises through a road beside it. Ramp: click where it starts and where it ends. Roads fitted to the terrain stay fitted. Esc ends the tool.
terrain.heightmap.hint: The ground as a grey picture, to shape in another program and bring back; openMapper reads and writes the same.
terrain.export.tooltip: Writes the ground of all tiles as a 16-bit grey PNG, a pixel per terrain point, with its lowest and highest height in a .txt beside it
terrain.import.tooltip: Lays a grey picture (PNG of 8 or 16 bits, or TIFF; a TIFF of real heights brings its metres) over all tiles, stretched to the map's outer edges
terrain.smoothing.tooltip: Passes of averaging each pixel with its neighbours, which hides the steps of an 8-bit picture
terrain.replace.tooltip: The picture's heights take the ground's place
terrain.add.tooltip: The picture's heights are added to the ground as it is, as hills on a slope
terrain.keep: Roads and objects keep their heights: best done before building. Roads fitted to the terrain are fitted again.
terrain.coarse: An 8-bit picture has only 256 steps of height: smoothing hides them.
